dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Even researchers should have a life that's their own.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a researcher?

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: I am, unfortunately.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: What is fortunate, however, is that I understand one thing better than the rest of my colleagues — research isn't the end-all and be-all of life.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: If you slog away at work all day, you'll get left behind in life, no matter how brilliant your research is.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: So, you've got to engage more with the people around you. Some drinking and chatting is the way to keep well, physically and mentally.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Even if the price you pay is doing twice the work in the evenings. But you see, students are always coming to the office during the day to ask this and that, so I might as well do my research at night to get some peace and quiet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Bye now. Keep in mind to enjoy your life!

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Let me think... How many days do I have before the deadline?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The deadline?

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's the last day I can submit my paper.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: I'm a night owl whose mind only works sharply at night. That means I have 50% less research time than others.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: As for during the day, if you ask me, it'd be a waste not to go out and enjoy the warm sunshine.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: I always make some time to rest and relax. My mind would become too stiff to think straight if I focused on research every hour of every day.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Enough chit-chat. I'm going to use the remaining 50% of my time efficiently. I have to come up with something before the deadline...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll leave you to it, then.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: Hmm... It's not too bad. I still have enough time, I suppose...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Take care of yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: *sigh* I know, I know. But I just can't see myself spending my whole life on research.

dialogues.speaker: Jafar
dialogues.text: It's fine. I'll try to drink more milk and sleep better. The same goes for you.
